recommendations.action: Check recent changes to transmit power, antenna tilt/azimuth and neighbour cells at the affected site, and restore planned values if a change reduced them.
recommendations.rationale: Low connection setup success rate and weak signal point to a possible configuration change reducing coverage, and successful configuration changes are degraded.
recommendations.expected_kpi_effect: Signal strength up and connection setup success rate up.
recommendations.verification: Signal strength and setup success recover to baseline and hold for several hours after the change.

recommendations.action: Check feeder/antenna alarms and VSWR readings at the site and dispatch field operations if hardware damage is indicated.
recommendations.rationale: A damaged antenna or feeder is a likely cause of very weak signal and failed call setups.
recommendations.expected_kpi_effect: Signal strength up (less negative dBm) and setup failures down.
recommendations.verification: Alarms clear, VSWR is within limits and signal strength normalizes on the site's cells.

recommendations.action: Map weak-signal reports against the predicted coverage of the serving and neighbouring cells to confirm whether a coverage hole exists.
recommendations.rationale: Confirms the main hypothesis of a coverage hole rather than a configuration or interference issue.
recommendations.expected_kpi_effect: No direct KPI change; narrows the root cause for targeted fixes.
recommendations.verification: Weak-signal areas are identified and compared with the planned coverage footprint.

recommendations.action: Measure uplink noise rise on the affected cells and mitigate any interference sources found.
recommendations.rationale: Interference can raise the noise floor and cause setup failures, and it cannot be excluded from the evidence.
recommendations.verification: Noise rise returns to normal and setup success stays stable over 24 hours.

recommendations.action: Optimize antenna tilt and azimuth and adjust neighbour relations so edge users are served by the best cell.
recommendations.rationale: Closes a confirmed coverage gap when settings are correct but footprint is insufficient.
recommendations.expected_kpi_effect: Signal strength up and setup success rate up at the cell edge.
recommendations.verification: Signal strength and setup success improve and remain stable for 24-48 hours without new degradations on neighbour cells.

recommendations.action: Plan additional coverage (small cell, indoor solution or new site) and schedule periodic drive tests if the weak area persists.
recommendations.rationale: Persistent weak signal needs capacity or coverage additions, and regular measurements catch gaps early.
recommendations.expected_kpi_effect: Sustained signal strength and setup success improvement.
recommendations.verification: Drive test or crowd-sourced data shows the gap closed and KPIs remain stable over weeks.

escalation.team: RAN optimization; field operations if hardware is faulty; radio planning if new coverage is needed
escalation.reason: Tilt and neighbour changes require RAN optimization, hardware repairs need field operations, and persistent gaps need radio planning per the runbook criteria.
